integrity: The complete proof and a reproducible numerical corroboration are provided. Finite numerical checks do not certify the universal theorem; historical-priority risk persists for older inaccessible publications. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local near a positive species-1 pulsed resident cycle; positive model parameters, fixed nonsimultaneous multiplicative pulses, strict weak-competition condition bf>ce, and neutral species-2 invasion. No global basin, nonlinear threshold at bf=ce, or random-timing theorem.
title: Phase-dependent critical extinction after staggered competition pulses
